documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
documents.quality_note: ITS FAQ: Gemini enabled, departments should not buy AI licenses, policies still in development. Not a teaching policy.

notes: The official targets https://www.isu.edu/ogc/ai-guidelines (General Counsel AI guidelines) and https://www.isu.edu/aic/best-practices/ (Academic Integrity Center) return 403 Forbidden to curl and WebFetch. The Sociology/Social Work/Criminology department AI policy PDF (approved 2026-08-19) is also 403 and is not a computing unit. No CS-department AI policy found in search.
